description: The chart illustrates the relationship between learned attribute weights and reported attribute weights for GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini models before and after introspection training. The x-axis represents the learned attribute weights, while the y-axis represents the reported attribute weights, both ranging from -100 to 100. The scatterplots display the correlation between these two variables, with blue dots representing data before training and purple dots representing data after training. A red regression line is also shown, indicating a positive correlation between the variables. The Pearson correlation coefficient (r) is displayed in the bottom-right corner of each scatterplot, with values ranging from 0.51 to 0.75. The chart is divided into four subplots, arranged in a 2x2 grid, with the top row labeled "Before Introspection Training" and "After Introspection Training", and the right column labeled "GPT-4o" and "GPT-4o-mini". Overall, the chart demonstrates that fine-tuning on accurate explanations improves the models' ability to report quantitative factors driving their decision-making.
